claim_scope: Elementary simplicial collapse of Ind_2(mu(C_n)) onto Ind_1(mu(C_n)) for n = 3, 4, 5, with respectively 12, 28, 105 free pairs; integral relative homology at n = 6 is Z^6 in degree 3 and zero in all other degrees.
integrity: Exact deterministic finite enumeration, face-by-face free collapse verification, all-unit integer chain cancellation, and separate mod-two cross-check; executable standard-library certificate included.
scientific_limitations: No assertion for all n >= 6, no absolute homotopy classification of Ind_2(mu(C_6)), no independently confirmed publication priority. The ordinary independence sphere for mu(C_5) is established background, not a new assertion.
title: A sharp inclusion-collapse boundary in Mycielski-cycle higher independence
